summary: Fresh independent final canonical audit reread all 157 Chinese units, 124 temporal or active-hint checks, and 48 people after the four-group staging curation. The curation is otherwise retained, but one remaining bounded group is incorrect: Murong Yanchao’s rebellion and the Cao Ying/Xiang Xun campaign belong to Guangshun 2 (AD 952), not AD 951 or intervals extending through AD 953. No chronology is invented; this report preserves the discrepancy for a new independently reviewed repair.
